# libyaml provenance

This directory contains the complete libyaml 0.2.5 source release from
<https://github.com/yaml/libyaml> at commit
`2c891fc7a770e8ba2fec34fc6b545c672beb37e6` (the commit referenced by the
annotated `0.2.5` tag).

The upstream files are unmodified. `meson.build` and this provenance note are
local integration files.
